name: sfcode
description: SFCode monorepo — Next.js client + Express backend for Salesforce developer practice.

scripts.build: npm run build -w sfcode-server && npm run build -w sfcode-client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w sfcode-client && npm run lint -w sfcode-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w sfcode-client && npm run typecheck -w sfcode-server
scripts.test: npm run test -w sfcode-server && npm run test -w sfcode-client
